summary: Implemented DatabricksOauthProfileMapping. Added cosmos/profiles/databricks/oauth.py (client_id from login, client_secret from password stored as env var COSMOS_CONN_DATABRICKS_CLIENT_SECRET, auth_type: oauth). It only claims connections whose extra JSON sets "auth_type": "oauth", so existing token connections are unaffected. Exported it from cosmos/profiles/databricks/__init__.py and registered it ahead of DatabricksTokenProfileMapping in cosmos/profiles/__init__.py. Added tests/profiles/databricks/test_dbr_oauth.py. Tests were not run, per instructions. Docs and CHANGELOG were not updated. Nothing committed.
